svg.text: One participant's Portitor in its dataspace: the dataspace authority and its issuer, the other members, the people and software inside the organisations, and the optional Gaia-X services
Dataspace: one dataspace authority and its members
Dataspace authority [organisation: runs the issuer, sets the rules]

their status lists, serves the signed schema and vocabulary
Sets the rules: who is a member, which issuer

plane, built-in data plane, DCP v1.0.1 wallet and verifier;

files; starts negotiations and transfers; asks for

Resolves its DID, reads its certificate
Resolves the notary's DID to check the
Calls; the arrow points from the caller
Only reads public documents (DID document, chain)

C4 model, level 1. Participants are organisations, each named by one DID: trust is system to system, and Portitor does not identify the people or applications inside them (ARCHITECTURE, "Who holds the credentials"; TD-02, TD-04). One Portitor serves one dataspace today (TD-03, a provider in several data spaces).
Gaia-X is optional: without PORTITOR_GAIAX_COMPLIANCE_URL, Portitor uses no Gaia-X service and no certificate.
